description_en: Invoke AddCases to add an outbound call list to a predictive dialing activity identified by a specified ID under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用AddCases添加外呼名单到指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动
kebab_example: aliyun ccc add-cases --instance-id ccc-test --campaign-id c58b9719-3bc3-441d-a4d3-fc0309ef7066 --case-list ReferenceId=01 Caller=185022xxxx PhoneNumber=1888880000 MaskedCallee=16600000066 CustomVariables=name_:_customer_,_客户标签_:_tag --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCases

parameters.help_en: The predictive outbound call activity ID
parameters.name: campaign_id

element_fields.help_en: The business ID, which is an identifier from the customer's operational system used in integration scenarios
element_fields.help_zh: 业务ID，客户业务系统标识，用于集成场景
element_fields.name: reference_id

element_fields.help_en: Customer-defined custom variables in JSON object format. The object can contain up to 10 properties, and both the name and value of each property are defined by the customer
element_fields.help_zh: 客户自定义变量，格式为JSON对象，对象最多包含10个属性，每个属性的名称和值均由客户自定义
element_fields.name: custom_variables

element_fields.help_en: The desensitized callee number. If this field is not empty, it indicates that the callee number must be desensitized. The desensitization rule is defined by the customer, and only the desensitized callee number needs to be provided here. Using a desensitized callee number means that in certain scenarios, the displayed callee number will be the desensitized version, and the real callee number cannot be viewed
element_fields.help_zh: 脱敏后的被叫号码，如果该字段不为空，表示需要对被叫号码脱敏，脱敏规则由客户自行定义，只需将脱敏后的被叫号码填入即可，使用脱敏被叫会导致某些场景下看到的是脱敏后的被叫号码，无法查看真实被叫号码
element_fields.name: masked_callee

element_fields.help_en: The caller number. If this field is specified, the corresponding contact will be called using this number instead of a randomly selected one
element_fields.help_zh: 主叫号码，该字段指定号码后，对应联系人将会使用对应的号码进行外呼，不再随机选择号码
element_fields.name: caller

parameters.help_en: The list of outbound call cases
parameters.name: case_list
